decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that this application for the installation of a conditioning unit to the rear of  Vantage West, Great West Road, would not harm the appearance the existing building or the character of the surrounding Conservation area. The proposal is considered to be in accordance with Policies ENVB 1.1 (New Development), ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas), ENVN 1.7 (Development near the Metropolitan Land Boundary), 	E 2.3 (Improvement of employment sites) and E 2.4 (Improvement of employment premises)
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
description: Installation of air conditioning condenser unit to the 3rd floor balcony located at the rear of existing building
